Premier Restaurants Malta has reopened its popular Sliema restaurant at Tigne’ Creek on July 12, showcasing a contemporary new design, following a major upgrade which required its temporary closure earlier this year.

Spread across 836m², McDonald’s Sliema restaurant is the brand’s largest in Malta.

The project saw a complete overhaul to the lobby and seating areas which can now accommodate 248 customers, with the latest innovations designed to elevate the experience for visiting guests. A modernized soft-play area for families dining in has also been introduced.

“We’re excited to bring our Sliema restaurant back to life and to welcome our regulars back. Following months of hard work, nearly 70 crew members have returned to their base and are more ready than ever to deliver feel-good moments to customers in a new environment, incorporating the technologies our fans have come to love” said Peter Hili, Managing Director of Premier Restaurants Malta.

Premier Capital is the Malta-based company which also operates McDonald’s in Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Greece and Romania.

To celebrate the reopening, McDonald’s is offering exclusive deals, including free delivery to Sliema residents throughout July through its delivery partners Bolt and Wolt and its App.

McDonald’s Sliema welcomed its first customers in 2013 and has since served over 5 million guests in this restaurant alone.

More than 450 crew at nine McDonald’s restaurants across Malta and Gozo serve over 20,000 customers every day.
